map.容积效率 ηv = 实际流量 qa ÷ 理论流量 qt × 100%；机械效率: Volumetric efficiency eta v = actual flow qa / theoretical flow qt x 100%; mechanical efficiency eta m = theoretical input torque Tt / actual input torque Ta x 100%; total efficiency eta = eta v x eta m; potential energy Ep = m * g * h (J); total power P = Ep / t / 1000 (kW); recovered power Pr = P x eta R; power loss = P - Pr; variable frequency saving = P * t * saving rate

map.有效功率 = 系统压力 × 实际流量，与电网输入功率比即得系统效率。: Effective power = system pressure x actual flow, and dividing by the grid input power gives the system efficiency.
map.泵站按输入电功率与有效液压功率算系统效率。: A pump station computes system efficiency from the input electrical power and the effective hydraulic power.
map.液压泵效率由容积效率与机械效率相乘得到：容积效率反映内泄漏（实际流量与理论流量之: Hydraulic pump efficiency is the product of volumetric and mechanical efficiency: the volumetric efficiency reflects internal leakage (actual flow over theoretical flow) and the mechanical efficiency reflects friction loss (theoretical torque over actual torque). A total efficiency below 70% is judged low. For energy recovery, the potential energy Ep = mgh is computed from the load mass and drop height, divided by the motion time to get the power, and multiplied by the recovery efficiency to get the recoverable power. For variable frequency savings, the daily consumption of the fixed frequency system is multiplied by the saving rate to estimate the daily and annual electricity saved and the carbon reduction (factor 0.785 kg CO2 per kWh).

map.：输入 100 kW、有效输出 92 kW、利用率 80% → 系统效率 = 9: : entering 100 kW, an effective output of 92 kW and a utilisation of 80% gives a system efficiency of 92 x 0.8 / 100 = 73.6%, with most of the remainder lost to overflow and throttling heat.
